lines.zh: 发出低沉嘶嘶声，移动缓慢而沉重
lines.en: Makes a deep hiss and moves slowly and heavily

lines.zh: 发出呻吟声，每步都显得挣扎
发出嘶嘶声，仿佛在痛苦中
发出低沉的咆哮，步履蹒跚
发出嘶嘶声，每步都艰难
发出痛苦的低吟，慢慢挪动
蹄子在石地上拖出长痕
lines.en: Its hooves drag long scars across the stone.
The cave wall weeps, and it wades closer.

lines.zh: 发出痛苦的低吟，盯着玩家
lines.en: Laments in pain, staring at the player

lines.zh: 我这具牛身里传出咕噜声。
lines.en: A gurgle comes from this cow body I wear.

lines.zh: 它低头啃着洞壁的苔藓
lines.en: It lowers its head and grazes cave moss.

lines.zh: 数日未动，它在积蓄力量
lines.en: Unmoving for days, it gathers strength.

lines.zh: 呼吸停了片刻，又忽然响起
lines.en: Its breath stops, then suddenly resumes.
Bones shift slowly beneath its hide.

lines.zh: 它把脸贴在岩壁上聆听
lines.en: It presses its face to the rock and listens.

lines.zh: 注意到玩家，发出嘶嘶声
盯着玩家，发出痛苦的低吟
lines.en: Stares at the player, laments in pain
Stares at the player, growls lowly

lines.zh: 注意到玩家，发出咕噜声
它抬头，乳白的眼窝对着你
lines.en: It lifts milky eye sockets toward you.
Across your mining lamp, it meets your eyes.

lines.zh: 它的瞳孔缩成一条细缝
lines.en: Its pupil narrows to a thin slit.
It tilts its head and studies your pickaxe.
Its gaze settles on your torch and stays.
It watches you through a crack in the rock.

lines.zh: 它没有眨眼，只慢慢转头
lines.en: It does not blink, only turns its head.

lines.zh: 它似乎记得你上次来过
lines.en: It seems to remember your last visit.
Your lamp dies, and it still watches you.

lines.zh: 它用鼻息试探你的位置
lines.en: It sniffs the air to place where you stand.

lines.zh: 它退后半步，又盯得更紧
lines.en: It steps back and stares harder.

lines.zh: 它把你的影子闻了又闻
lines.en: It sniffs and sniffs at your shadow.
My hide is torn open in the dark.

lines.zh: 草料的味道，让我记起自己是什么。
lines.en: The smell of fodder reminds me what I was.

lines.zh: 我这张牛脸，你看得太久了。
lines.en: You have stared at this cow face long enough.
Get away or I'll eat you!

lines.zh: 你身上有我想要的东西！
快靠近我！我会让你饱餐一顿！
lines.en: Come closer! I'll feast on you!

lines.zh: 你身上的味道吸引了我！

lines.en: Come closer, I have food for you!

lines.zh: 骨头里传来不属于牛的叫声。
lines.en: A cry not bovine rises from my bones.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴下的水，替我数着日子。
lines.en: The drips from the cave roof count my days.

lines.zh: 牛角是假的，别信你看见的。
lines.en: The horns are a lie; don't trust your eyes.
Something under this hide is wrong.

lines.zh: 我的皮下面，有东西在爬。
你的触碰让我感到威胁！
你很适合我，适合留在这层洞穴。
lines.en: You suit me, suited to stay on this cave level.

lines.zh: 这具牛的身子，也在找同伴。
lines.en: Even this cow-shaped body looks for a mate.
You make me want to mate!

lines.zh: 它对深渊发出求偶的长哞
lines.en: It lows a long courtship call into the abyss.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处回响着低沉的叫声。
lines.en: A deep moan echoes from the cave depths.
This cow body is only an empty shell.
Come closer, I want to taste you.
Come closer, let me see you.

lines.zh: 你踩进了我嚼过的苔藓。
lines.en: You stepped into the moss I chewed.

lines.zh: 越深的洞，我越像真的牛。
lines.en: Deeper in the cave, the more I resemble a cow.
You will end in my hands.
You have stepped into its cave level.
Its muscles tighten for the first time.
It has memorized the sound of your steps.

lines.zh: 你今天来得比上次更深
lines.en: Today you came deeper than before.

lines.zh: 它从积水里站起，选定了你
lines.en: It rises from the standing water and chooses you.
You're about to be my dinner.

lines.zh: 四条腿，走了不属于我的步子。
lines.en: Four legs walking a gait that isn't mine.

lines.zh: 你离我这么近，无法逃脱。
你很快就会是我的猎物。

lines.en: Your blood will soon run out.

lines.zh: 它步步紧逼，蹄印带着黏液
lines.en: It closes in, leaving slime-filled hoofprints.
It circles you and blocks the way back.

lines.zh: 它把身体压低，准备冲撞
lines.en: It lowers its bulk, ready to charge.
It is counting the beats of your heart.

lines.zh: 喉里滚出不属于牛的声响
lines.en: A sound no cow should make rolls from its throat.
You step back once; it advances twice.
The tunnel is narrow, so it squeezes closer.

lines.zh: 它嗅着你的汗，越嗅越急
lines.en: It sniffs your sweat, faster and faster.

lines.zh: 它守在拐角，算准你会来
lines.en: It waits at the corner, sure you will come.

lines.zh: 它把犄角对准你的胸口
lines.en: It levels its horns at your chest.

lines.zh: 你闻到了吗？我的触手在你周围！
lines.en: You smell it? My tentacles around you!
Its horns crash into your ribs.
It throws its whole weight at you.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩碎了你脚边的石头
lines.en: A hoof shatters the stone by your feet.
It bites down on your arm.
It whips its head and slams you into the wall.

lines.zh: 皮下骨刺划破你的衣袖
lines.en: Bone spurs under its hide tear your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我从岩缝里挤出牛的形状。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the crevice in bovine shape.
Deep in the cave, hooves arrive before the shape.

lines.zh: 几天之后，它到了这一层
lines.en: Days later, it reaches this level.

lines.zh: 岩缝里挤出潮湿的呼吸
lines.en: Wet breath seeps out of the rock seam.

lines.zh: 它的骨架在黑暗中拼合
lines.en: Its skeleton reassembles in the dark.
The cattle below stopped grazing long ago.

lines.zh: 第一声低哞来自你脚下
lines.en: The first low moo comes from beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 它从废弃矿道尽头走来
lines.en: It walks out from the end of an abandoned shaft.

lines.zh: 阴影里多了牛形的轮廓
lines.en: A cow-shaped outline joins the shadows.

lines.zh: 它闻到新鲜空气便上来了
lines.en: It smelled fresh air and climbed up.

lines.zh: 矿井支柱在它身后折断
痛苦扭曲我的身体，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Pain twists my form! — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我感到剧痛，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I feel intense pain! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤在燃烧，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My skin burns! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我被撕裂了，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm torn apart! — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我无法承受，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I can't bear it! — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我的骨骼在折断，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My bones are breaking! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 黑暗吞噬了我，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Darkness devours me! — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我感到虚弱，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I feel weak! — and the void makes it worse.
